sampling_measure: physical-channel ring-polymer canonical measure times centroid flux metric, with umbrella; pCN uses exact free-ring Gaussian prior
time_semantics: Monte Carlo sweeps, not real-time RPMD propagation

analysis.uncertainty_unit: independent exchange ladder; temporal blocks retain all windows together

stopping_rule: Stop/refine using numerical precision, stationarity and independent seed evidence. Retain all predetermined seeds and all prefixes; do not select a seed/time segment or fit a rate prefactor to match the paper. A converged systematic discrepancy triggers diagnosis rather than more sampling until accidental agreement.
recrossing: New PyRPMD constrained parents and unthermostatted children after a stable PMF; existing pilot kappa is not reused.
hardware: shared existing 8 CPU-equivalent, 8GiB environment; no GPU or paid compute requested
